other_conditions: The beneficiary must be a resident of Meghalaya
The beneficiary must be engaged in building or other construction work
The beneficiary must be registered under the Meghalaya Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
The beneficiary must have continuous membership for 3 years
A registered worker can avail of financial assistance for their own marriage only once
A registered worker can apply for financial assistance for the marriage of all their adult children
Proper documentation such as marriage certificates must be produced for the marriage of adult children
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹5,000 is provided for the worker's own marriage and for the marriage of all their adult children.
